title: PostReady: PR #595 — 'Write another caption' button
description: Added a 'Write another caption' button so users can regenerate captions inline without restarting the creation flow, improving iteration speed.

title: PostReady: PR #594 — Fix metrics collector IG reach call + Graph error visibility
description: Fixed the Instagram metrics collector — IG reach API call corrected and Graph API errors are now surfaced with visibility, improving reliability of the post analytics cron job.

title: PostReady: PR #593 — Onboarding requires business name + auto-generates first post
description: Onboarding now requires a business name before proceeding (Next button disabled until entered), and automatically generates the user's first post during setup to reduce time-to-value.

title: PostReady: PR #592 — Weekly digest email (the retention loop)
description: Added a Monday-morning weekly digest email per active client showing post reach, engagement stats, top post, pack usage, and days since last post — closing the retention loop.

title: PostReady: PR #591 — Post analytics (metrics collection cron + pack Results card)
description: Added post analytics infrastructure: a metrics collection cron job and a pack Results card so users can see performance data for their published posts.

title: PostReady: PR #590 — Prompt-based text-intent detection routes to text model
description: Added prompt-based text-intent detection that automatically routes text-heavy prompts to the appropriate text model, improving output quality for text-centric content.

title: PostReady: PR #588 — Restore Stripe apiVersion to unbreak prod deploys
description: Fixed a Stripe apiVersion mismatch between code and pnpm-lock that was breaking production deploys, restoring deployment stability.

title: PostReady: PR #587 — Quality instrumentation (generation_events + publish-ready metric)
description: Added quality instrumentation tracking generation_events and a publish-ready metric to monitor and improve image generation quality over time.

title: PostReady: PR #586 — Auto-QA gate on generated images with one corrected retry
description: Added an automatic quality-assurance gate that evaluates generated images and triggers a corrected retry when quality does not meet the threshold, reducing bad outputs reaching users.

title: PostReady: PR #565 — Fix homepage TikTok link points at our handle
description: Fixed the TikTok link on the homepage to correctly point to PostReady's own TikTok handle rather than an incorrect or placeholder URL.
